title: A rejected proposal can still be issued as an Effective policy
desc: Create proposal → proposal-reject (SUCCESS, ProposalStatus=4) → issue returns HTTP 200 with a new PolicyNo (POTL00100000016, PolicyStatus=2). Checker rejection is bypassable; business control failure.
spec: Policy Lifecycle – Approval Process (approve or reject)
rec: Block issue (and update) when ProposalStatus = Rejected; return a clear 4xx.

title: Policy can be issued without LC Code, LG Code or payment/debit details
desc: Proposal saved without PolicyPaymentInfoList and then issued → POTL00100000003 Effective. Spec: LC Code, LG Code, Premium mandatory before policy conversion.
spec: Fields sheet – LC Code / LG Code 'Mandatory (before policy conversion)'
rec: Enforce mandatory payment fields (and validate LG/LC against master) in the issue step.

title: Sum Insured is double-counted – PlanList contains a duplicate, empty plan entry
desc: Every proposal response contains 2 PlanList entries (2nd has no PlanId/PlanName but all coverages). Policy/LOB/Risk SumInsured = 2× the selected plan (Plan 1 With Travel: 62,000 instead of 31,000; Plan 2: 122,000 instead of 61,000).
rec: Return only the selected plan; fix SumInsured roll-up. Verify Production Report / feed totals are not affected.

title: Product Name in feed is wrong for Term Life policies
desc: Feed rows for TL001 policies show 'Personal Accident with TTD' / 'Personal Accident without TTD'. Expected 'Term Life with Travel' / 'Term Life without Travel'.
rec: Fix product-name mapping (ProductSubcode → name) in feed template.

title: Cancelled Date populated for non-cancelled (Effective) policies
desc: 6 of 6 Effective policies in the feed carry a Cancelled Date equal to the issue timestamp.
rec: Populate only when policy status = Cancelled.

title: Beneficiary share total is not validated
desc: Shares 50 (single), 60+60, 150, -100 and a blank beneficiary name were all accepted. Forms state 'Share % (total to equal 100%)'.
rec: Validate Σshare = 100, each 0<share≤100, name mandatory, at least one beneficiary.

title: Mandatory fields are not enforced by the back-end
desc: Proposal created successfully with InsuredName, DateOfBirth, Gender, IdNo, IdType, Salutation, ResidentStatus, Email, Mobile, MaritalStatus, Address, CIFNumber, CustomerType, BranchCode or PremiumModeCode omitted (14 of 16 tested). Only PlanId is enforced (via an iHub exception).
rec: Add mandatory-field validation in the Create/Update Proposal API (UI-only validation is bypassable).

title: Monthly premium mode accepted for Term Life
desc: PremiumModeCode=3 creates a TL proposal (premium unchanged at 216). Monthly is meant only for Life Protect; Term Life = Annual & Single.
spec: Premium & Rates / LOV – Premium Mode is product-wise

title: Policy term / expiry not validated or derived
desc: Annual with term 2, Single with term 0 and 11 accepted; PolicyTerm and ExpiryDate are independent (term 5 with 1-year expiry accepted). With a consistent expiry the certificate is correct (TL-TERM-08).
spec: Fields sheet – Term (Single 2–10 yrs; min/max configurable per product)
rec: Derive ExpiryDate from term; enforce Annual=1 and Single min/max (configurable).

title: Data-quality validations missing
desc: Accepted: invalid email, alphabetic mobile, negative salary, 300-char name, IdType=9, MaritalStatus=9, ExpiryDate earlier than EffectiveDate, back-dated EffectiveDate.
rec: Add format/range/code-table validation; reject illogical dates.

title: Repeat cancel-check on a pending request returns stale data and skips validation
desc: After the first cancel-check creates a PENDING request, later calls with different CancellationDate return the first request's calculation (e.g. day 0 / FREE_LOOK 216 even for a 2027-01-13 date) and bypass before-commencement / after-expiry checks.
rec: Recalculate and validate each request, or reject with 'request already pending'.

title: Free-look period mismatch: system 15 days vs application form 30 days
desc: cancel-check FreeLookDays=15; Day-15 cancellation falls to pro-rata. Application form 'Review Period' promises full refund within 30 days.
rec: Align configuration with the form (or correct the form).

title: Carrier name inconsistent: 'Afillar Insurance Company' vs 'Arabia Falcon Insurance'
desc: cancel-check and cancel-approve return CarrierCode AFIC / 'Afillar Insurance Company'; certificate and application form show 'Arabia Falcon Insurance SAOG'.
rec: Correct carrier master data / notification templates.

title: Application form: English cancellation clause prints '8096 of the unearned Premium'; footer 'Page 2 of 3' truncated
desc: Static clause renders '80%' as '8096' on page 2 of the generated application form (Arabic side correct). Page-number footer is clipped.
rec: Fix the template (escape '%' / font) and footer width.

title: Blank certificate generated for non-existent policy and for un-issued proposal
desc: doc_generation DocType=Policy returns HTTP 200 + empty-field PDF for POTL00199999999 and for a PTL… proposal number.
spec: Policy Lifecycle – certificate printed after approval
rec: Return 404/400 when policy not found or not issued.

title: Business-validation errors return HTTP 500 INTERNAL_ERROR and leak internal details
desc: Invalid codes/plan/product etc. return HTTP 500 with iHub URLs, Java exceptions (e.g. NPE text in load-policy for unknown policy). Some not-found cases return HTTP 200 with validateResult.errors. Cancellation APIs, by contrast, return proper 400/404/409.
rec: Standardise to 4xx with field-level messages; hide internal stack/URLs.

title: ChannelCode not enforced as a data boundary
desc: get-plans accepts a missing or unknown ChannelCode; an issued policy can be loaded with ChannelCode=OTHER.
rec: Validate ChannelCode against the token's channel and scope data access.

title: Feed missing Branch Code, LCCode, LGCode columns; invalid Module accepted
desc: Feed has 27 columns; spec lists 30. Module='Nope' still returns an xlsx.
rec: Add the three columns; validate Module.
